title: Keel (KEEL) Sells Entire Bitcoin Treasury for $192 Million, Will Sell BTC Daily
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Keel (KEEL) Sells Entire Bitcoin Treasury for $192 Million, Will Sell BTC Daily Keel sold 2,520 bitcoin in the third quarter, left its treasury near zero and said Quebec-mined coins will now be sold every day as it pivots to AI data centers. This post Keel (KEEL) Sells Entire Bitcoin Treasury for $192 Million, Will Sell BTC Daily first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
